title: Talking About Performance or Paying for It? A Field Experiment on Performance Reviews and Incentives
authors: Kathrin Manthei; Dirk Sliwka; Timo Vogelsang
eligible_reason: Randomized 2x2 field experiment in 224 retail stores with one common start date for all treated stores; not a staggered-adoption design. The main panel regressions (Table 2; do file lines 44-90) are xtreg profits profits_p treatment_bonus treatment_review treatment_bonus_review refurbishment_prio_y refurbishment_past_y i.time, fe over months 37-54: three simultaneous treatment-arm indicators (additional treatments), a lagged outcome (profits_p, prior-year same-month profits) and time-varying refurbishment controls in every column. Event-time versions (Tr1P..Tr3P month-by-arm interactions) share the same structure. Remaining tables are cross-sectional survey regressions and probits.
design_notes: Stata xtreg, fe / reghdfe absorb(time dis_manager_ID str_manager_ID store). Store x month panel, Region 303 (North), stores without manager changes. Columns 2 and 4 add district-manager and store-manager FE. boottest wild-cluster bootstrap p-values.
data_files_note: readme.txt: data are proprietary to the retail firm and not posted; requests go through the authors. Package ships only the do file, log, variable dictionary and dataset description.
screener_notes: Screened from package and OpenAlex abstract. Common-start randomized experiment with three arms, lagged outcome and time-varying controls; proprietary data not shipped.
